title: gaja writefreely update/delete: no auth check
description: In gaja/src/writefreely_api.rs, update_post (line 54) and delete_post (line 71) have no authentication or authorization checks. Any unauthenticated request can update or delete any article by ID. Compare with smallhold/src/writefreely_api.rs which checks edit tokens on both operations, or the create_post handler in the same file which calls auth.require_scope("write"). This is a straightforward auth bypass for article mutation in the multi-tenant server.
